help_menu:
✦ Command Center ✦
Explore all commands below. All commands start with /
help_admins:
🛡 Admin Commands
▸ /pause — Pause the stream ▸ /resume — Resume the stream ▸ /skip — Skip the current track ▸ /stop — Stop the stream ▸ /seek [sec/min:sec] — Seek to position ▸ /seekback [duration] — Rewind backward ▸ /seekforward [duration] — Fast forward ▸ /loop [disable/single/queue] — Set loop mode ▸ /shuffle — Shuffle the queue ▸ /channelplay — Setup channel playback ▸ /reload — Reload admin cache ▸ /bots — Show bots in the group ▸ /groupdata — Show group information
help_auth:
🔐 Authorization Commands
Authorized users can control playback without being admins. ▸ /auth — Add a user to the auth list ▸ /unauth — Remove a user from the auth list ▸ /authlist — View authorized users
help_blchat:
🚫 Chat Blacklist
Blacklisted chats cannot use the bot. ▸ /blacklistchat [chat_id] — Blacklist a chat ▸ /whitelistchat [chat_id] — Remove from blacklist ▸ /blacklistedchat — View all blacklisted chats
help_bluser:
🚷 User Blacklist
Blacklisted users cannot use the bot. ▸ /block [user_id] — Block a user ▸ /unblock [user_id] — Unblock a user ▸ /blockedusers — View all blocked users
help_gban:
⚡ Global Ban (Gban)
Globally ban users across all groups. ▸ /gban [user_id] [reason] — Globally ban a user ▸ /ungban [user_id] — Remove global ban ▸ /gbanlist — View all globally banned users
help_loop:
🔁 Loop Commands
▸ /loop — View current loop mode ▸ /loop disable — Disable loop ▸ /loop single — Loop current track only ▸ /loop queue — Loop the entire queue
help_seek:
⏩ Seek Commands
▸ /seek [duration] — Seek to a specific time ▸ /seekback [duration] — Rewind backward ▸ /seekforward [duration] — Fast forward Example: /seek 1:30 or /seek 90
help_shuffle:
🔀 Shuffle
▸ /shuffle — Randomly shuffle the current queue order
help_maintenance:
🔧 Maintenance Mode
Only Sudo users can use the bot when maintenance is enabled. ▸ /maintenance — View current status ▸ /maintenance enable — Enable maintenance mode ▸ /maintenance disable — Disable maintenance mode
help_ping:
📡 Ping & General
▸ /help — Show the help menu ▸ /ping — Check latency and memory usage ▸ /start — Start the bot ▸ /sudolist — View Sudo users list
help_play:
🎵 Playback Commands
▸ /play [song/link/reply] — Play audio in voice chat ▸ /vplay [song/link/reply] — Play video (if enabled) ▸ /cplay [song/link] — Play in linked channel ▸ /cvplay [song/link] — Play video in linked channel ▸ /playforce — Force play (skip queue) ▸ /vplayforce — Force play video ▸ /radio — Play online radio Live Control Buttons: ▸ ⏪ « 10 / « 30 — Rewind backward ▸ ⏩ 10 » / 30 » — Fast forward ▸ ⏸ ▶ — Pause / Resume ▸ ↺ — Replay current track ▸ ⏭ — Skip to next ▸ ⏹ — Stop playback Channel Play: ▸ /channelplay linked — Enable for linked channel ▸ /channelplay [channel_id] — Enable for specific channel ▸ /channelplay disable — Disable channel playback
help_queue:
📋 Queue Commands
▸ /queue — View queued tracks ▸ /shuffle — Shuffle the queue ▸ /loop — Toggle loop mode
help_sudo:

▸ /ac — Active calls count ▸ /activevc — List active calls ▸ /broadcast [reply] — Broadcast to all chats • -nochat Exclude groups • -user Include users • -copy Without forward tag ▸ /eval — Execute code snippet ▸ /leave — Make bot leave current chat ▸ /leaveall — Make assistants leave inactive chats ▸ /logs — Send log file ▸ /logger [on/off] — Toggle logger ▸ /restart — Restart the bot ▸ /update — Update from git and restart ▸ /addsudo — Add a Sudo user ▸ /rmsudo — Remove a Sudo user
